/** The type of the typedef R<[]string>. */
export interface RStringList {
  readonly x: readonly string[];
  readonly pos: number;
}

/** The type of the typedef List<int>. */
export type ListInt =
  | { readonly tag: "Nil" }
  | { readonly tag: "Cons"; readonly value: ListIntCons };

/** The type of the typedef List<int>. */
export interface ListIntCons {
  readonly h: number;
  readonly t: ListInt;
}

/** The type of the typedef R<List<int>>. */
export interface RListInt {
  readonly x: ListInt;
  readonly pos: number;
}

/** The type of the typedef R<int>. */
export interface RInt {
  readonly x: number;
  readonly pos: number;
}

/** The type of the parameters of P. */
export interface PArgs {
  readonly r: RStringList;
  readonly s: RStringList;
  readonly m: ReadonlyMap<string, RInt>;
}

/** A typedef. */
export type Toks = RStringList;

// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc P: `POST /api/p` on http server web-api. */
export async function p(args: { readonly r: $t.RStringList; readonly s: $t.RStringList; readonly m: ReadonlyMap<string, $t.RInt> }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<$t.RListInt> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/p", {
    "r": $enc_RStringList(args.r),
    "s": $enc_RStringList(args.s),
    "m": $encMap($stringKey, $enc_RInt)(args.m),
  }, opts);
  return $dec_RListInt(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_RStringList(x: $t.RStringList): unknown {
  return {
    "x": $encList($encString)(x.x),
    "pos": $encInt(x.pos),
  };
}

export function $dec_RStringList(v: unknown, at: string): $t.RStringList {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    x: $decList($decString)($field(o, "x", at), at + ".x"),
    pos: $decInt($field(o, "pos", at), at + ".pos"),
  };
}

export function $enc_ListInt(x: $t.ListInt): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "Nil") return "Nil";
  if (x.tag === "Cons") return { "Cons": $enc_ListIntCons(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "ListInt");
}

export function $dec_ListInt(v: unknown, at: string): $t.ListInt {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "Nil" && p === $bare) return { tag: "Nil" };
  if (tag === "Cons" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Cons", value: $dec_ListIntCons(p, at + ".Cons") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "ListInt");
}

export function $enc_ListIntCons(x: $t.ListIntCons): unknown {
  return {
    "h": $encInt(x.h),
    "t": $enc_ListInt(x.t),
  };
}

export function $dec_ListIntCons(v: unknown, at: string): $t.ListIntCons {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    h: $decInt($field(o, "h", at), at + ".h"),
    t: $dec_ListInt($field(o, "t", at), at + ".t"),
  };
}

export function $enc_RListInt(x: $t.RListInt): unknown {
  return {
    "x": $enc_ListInt(x.x),
    "pos": $encInt(x.pos),
  };
}

export function $dec_RListInt(v: unknown, at: string): $t.RListInt {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    x: $dec_ListInt($field(o, "x", at), at + ".x"),
    pos: $decInt($field(o, "pos", at), at + ".pos"),
  };
}

export function $enc_RInt(x: $t.RInt): unknown {
  return {
    "x": $encInt(x.x),
    "pos": $encInt(x.pos),
  };
}

export function $dec_RInt(v: unknown, at: string): $t.RInt {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    x: $decInt($field(o, "x", at), at + ".x"),
    pos: $decInt($field(o, "pos", at), at + ".pos"),
  };
}

export function $enc_PArgs(x: $t.PArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "r": $enc_RStringList(x.r),
    "s": $enc_RStringList(x.s),
    "m": $encMap($stringKey, $enc_RInt)(x.m),
  };
}

export function $dec_PArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.PArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    r: $dec_RStringList($field(o, "r", at), at + ".r"),
    s: $dec_RStringList($field(o, "s", at), at + ".s"),
    m: $decMap($stringKey, $dec_RInt)($field(o, "m", at), at + ".m"),
  };
}

// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";
import type * as $t from "./types";

/**
 * Runs proc P through p (`POST /api/p` on http server web-api): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useP(args?: { readonly r: $t.RStringList; readonly s: $t.RStringList; readonly m: ReadonlyMap<string, $t.RInt> } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly r: $t.RStringList; readonly s: $t.RStringList; readonly m: ReadonlyMap<string, $t.RInt> }, $t.RListInt> {
  return $useCall($c.p, args, opts);
}
